name: huayuan-schedule-butler-v2
description: Unifies SCUT undergraduate course schedules, assignments, exams and notices into explainable, editable task cards and day/week plans, including a weather-aware University Town campus walking-route planner with major input, official timetable import, exam-prep tasks and manual todos.

profession.zh: 华园本科生日程规划助理

displayDescription.en: Unifies SCUT University Town timetables, assignments and campus opportunities into explainable plans, with a live first action, adaptive rescheduling, exam-prep tasks, weather-aware walking routes and a three-page split-screen dashboard.
displayDescription.zh: 面向华南理工大学大学城校区，聚合多平台课表、作业、考试、校园通知与活动；提供“现在干什么”、临时重排、T-14/T-7/T-3/T-1 复习任务、天气感知校园路线，以及“今日 / 全部待办 / 可参与事项”三页驾驶舱。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请告诉我你能帮我做什么，并引导我完成首次初始化
defaultInitPrompt.en: Show me what you can do and guide me through first-time setup

quickPrompts.zh: 请告诉我你能帮我做什么，并引导我完成首次初始化
quickPrompts.en: Show me what you can do and guide me through first-time setup

quickPrompts.zh: 我现在该干什么？请给出唯一的第一动作和接下来的安排
quickPrompts.en: What should I do right now? Give me the single next action and the following schedule

quickPrompts.zh: 我要临时加一门课、一项作业或一段休息，请帮我重排本周计划
quickPrompts.en: Add a temporary class, assignment, or rest block, and reschedule my week
